name: Trainer Rematch RoddSoft
description: Talk to beaten trainers for a rematch in Gen 1 (Red/Blue/Yellow) and Gen 2 (Gold/Silver/Crystal). Rematch money and XP are configurable percentages of the usual amounts (MODS menu, 0-100% in 10% steps), every class opens with a line in its own voice, and a much stronger rematch team draws a second warning prompt.
